## Highlights

The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022:

- Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed.
- Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost.

versions.name: v5.1.35
versions.body:
**The omo-senpi typecheck gives the same result wherever the checkout sits.** It used to pick up `@types/node` from folders above the checkout, so a stray older copy there failed the typecheck while CI passed on the same commit. omo-senpi now declares its own `@types/node` and `bun-types` and reads type packages only from its own `node_modules`. ([#10320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10320), [#10332](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10332))

**Memory items sync without losing concurrent edits, even from a stale device.** The sync item model captures a device's edits against the exact snapshot it saw, so a stale capture merges as a concurrent edit instead of silently dropping work or throwing; two captures from one device on one baseline lose nothing, multiline and quoted frontmatter values render as valid YAML on every replica, and path keys that would split one file into several (empty segments, trailing slashes, backslashes, drive letters) are rejected instead of canonicalized. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10203](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10203))

**A `categories` entry named after an agent now gets a warning instead of being silently ignored.** A `task(subagent_type: "plan-consultant")` spawn reads only `agents."plan-consultant"`, so a model chain put under `categories."plan-consultant"` never reached it and the spawn ran the builtin chain, while `omo doctor` still counted that category as usable. Whenever a `categories.<name>` key equals a builtin agent or an agent in your `agents` config, and that agent does not already set its own models, the startup notice and `omo doctor` now say that key is not read for that spawn and show the corrected snippet with your own chain, for example `"agents": { "plan-consultant": { "models": [...] } }`; `agents.<name>.models` stays the one way to set an agent's models. Resolution is unchanged. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10323](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10323), [#10326](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10326))

**A steering message to a background task is never recorded as both failed and delivered.** When a steer timed out and its retry was still in flight while a later run of the parent reconciled the task's unconfirmed inputs, that run marked the message failed and the retry then delivered it, so the task's log said both. Reconciliation now leaves an input whose retry is in flight to that retry, which records the one real outcome ([#10165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10165)).

**Memory reflection no longer dies in the sandbox when its session directory does not exist yet.** The Linux sandbox now creates each writable directory it binds (mode 0700) right before bwrap binds it, and every reflection launch first backfills the identity's runtime directories, so an identity created before `runtime/reflection-sessions` existed reflects normally instead of failing with "Can't find source path". An off or unavailable sandbox still creates nothing. Thanks to [@leeseunguk](https://github.com/leeseunguk) and [@AceRothstein71](https://github.com/AceRothstein71) (#7236). ([#7012](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7012), [#8004](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/8004))

**A missing reflection directory no longer gets "turn the sandbox off" advice.** When memory reflection fails because a sandbox bind directory does not exist yet, the notice now names that directory and how to create it, instead of blaming user namespaces and suggesting `memory.reflection.sandbox: "off"`. A real user-namespace refusal still gets the host fix first, with turning the sandbox off only as a last resort. ([#10317](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10317), [#10319](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10319))

**Opening and closing an OmO session without a message no longer leaves an empty session in `/resume`.** The memory component's hidden session binding is now written as startup bookkeeping, so senpi removes a session that never had a conversation. ([#10168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10168), [#10308](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10308))

**A task shard host now exits once its children are done instead of staying alive for days.** When a task child's session parked or closed on its shard, the child's own connection to that shard stayed open, so the shard kept counting the connections and its idle exit never fired; one shard served zero sessions for two days with 18 connections back to itself. Those connections now close when the session ends, and a refused close no longer strands its client ([#10062](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10062), [#10066](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10066)).

**Computer use can hold keys or a mouse button for a set time and always lets go.** `holdKeys(keys, { duration })` and `holdMouse(x, y, { duration })` hold for up to 100 seconds and release everything they pressed, in reverse order, even when the run is cancelled or the emergency stop fires. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651), [#10030](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10030))

**A child task keeps reporting the model it is actually running.** A `set_model` or model cycle applied to a child by any client, and a fallback that later reverts, now update the child's record as they happen: `task_output`, `/tasks`, the desktop task snapshot and the completion notice show the live model, and a switch omo did not make is marked `(switched by operator)`. The persisted record keeps `effective_model.source` within the values earlier builds parse (the live switch detail moves into a nested block those builds ignore), so a downgrade or an older omo sharing the task store still loads these records. ([#10020](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10020), [#10097](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10097))

**`OMO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` turns OmO Native telemetry fully off, and an opted-out session leaves nothing behind for a later one to send.** Every opt-out (`OMO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, `DO_NOT_TRACK`, the PostHog switches and the config flag) now goes through one consent check, taken when the session starts and again before anything is written or hashed: an opted-out session derives no session hash, creates no salt or notice marker, and writes no summary file. Events now carry a time-ordered random `event_id`, are keyed by a hash of the install id instead of the machine (the old machine hash rides along until 2026-12-14 so earlier rows still join), and mark CI runs with a plain `ci` flag. Turning telemetry off while a session is running now stops that session's events within a few seconds, including the raw per-turn row a sampled session kept sending ([#10328](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10328)). QA drivers that start the real runtime opt out of telemetry through one shared helper. ([#10226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10226))

Fixed: OmO Native versions v5.0.0-beta.6 through v5.1.34 kept sending usage events for the rest of a session after telemetry was turned off while that session was running ([#10328](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10328)). These events are personless and carry a session hash; the ones confirmed in that report are `turn_completed`, `feature_used` and `computer_use_activation`, other usage events may have been sent the same way, and like every OmO Native event they never contain prompt or response text, file paths, or file contents. Turning telemetry off before a session started, or through one of the opt-out environment variables, was never affected. Since v5.1.35 consent is checked when events are sent (a check is reused for at most 5 seconds), and events already queued are dropped once the opt-out is read. Those events can't be told apart from consented ones, so erasure is per install: send a private request through this repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/security/advisories/new), titled "Telemetry erasure request", with your install id (the file `omo-senpi/omo-native/install-id` under the agent home), and an operator erases that install's events. Put the id only in that private report, never in a public issue or comment. Events from older versions that are keyed only by the machine hash are erased along with your install's events only where our records pair that hash with your install id and no other install. A history shared by several machines or installs (the same hostname hash) is not erased that way: name it in the private request, and it is erased only if the request proves the events are yours. ([#10226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10226))

**Sessions load about 33 KB less code at startup, because the memory palace and `/people` now load on first use.** The `/palace` viewer generator and the `/people` roster, record and `--ask` runtime moved out of the entry bundle into their own file, which is loaded the first time either command runs, the same way `/doctor` and `/memfs` already work. Both commands print and notify exactly what they did before. If that file is missing or broken, the command now says so and tells you to reinstall omo and start a new session, instead of failing silently. ([#10300](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10300))

**The memory sync device keyring refuses a few more malformed inputs instead of failing late.** A keyring record can no longer carry the snapshot tag as its type, deeply nested JSON (over 64 levels) is refused with a typed error instead of a stack overflow, the wrap associated data goes through the one RFC 8785 serializer and refuses a non-integer epoch, and a low-order X25519 point is refused with the normal "does not open" error. Follow-up to the review of [#10194](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10194) ([#10274](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10274)).

**Background task reattachment now recovers the real result instead of starting duplicate work.** A parent that reloads or loses its host connection checks whether the child is still running before reading its transcript. Finished turns are adopted once, interrupted turns continue once, and a turn stopped by its deadline stays interrupted until an explicit `task_send`. ([#10012](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10012), [#10013](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10013), [#10078](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10078)).

**The ulw-research report checker no longer counts an invisible image as the report's visual.** An image or chart with any zero dimension, such as `width="600" height="0"` or an inline `height: 0`, no longer satisfies the rule that every final report carries a visual; one with no declared size still counts, since the browser sizes it. ([#10266](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10266), [#10268](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10268))

**Computer use no longer asks to confirm foreground control in full access mode.** A full-access session grants it directly and shows a note with the reason; other modes still ask, headless runs still never grant, and the grant still ends with the turn, on release or on the stop chord. Reported by Q. ([#10022](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10022), [#10024](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10024))

**`omo update` no longer offers to overwrite a binary your package manager installed.** When the compiled `omo` is owned by pacman, dpkg, rpm, Homebrew or Nix, `omo update` used to print a `curl … && mv` replace command that either failed on a root-owned path or left the package manager tracking a file it no longer installed. It now exits non-zero and names the package and the manager's own upgrade command (for example `brew upgrade omo`). The ownership probe fails open: a missing tool or an unowned path keeps the old behavior. Thanks to @cynkai. ([#9585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9585), [#9629](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9629))

**Memory reflection notices name the failing run's log by its real path.** The parked notice, the reflection-failing health alert and `/memory doctor` told you to inspect `runtime/reflection-sessions/<runId>/child-stderr.log`, a relative path with a literal `<runId>` under a directory runs are not kept in. They now name the newest failing run's absolute `child-stderr.log` (home shortened to `~`), and when that run was already pruned they say so and point at the stderr tail kept in the failure detail. Thanks to @cynkai. ([#9497](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9497), [#9505](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9505))

versions.body:
**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.13: a busy host gives memory back when its sessions end.** An RPC host serving many sessions used to keep the heap of every session it had run until it exited, so a long day of terminal-heavy work held its peak footprint; it now returns freed heap as sessions drop ([senpi#3240](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3240), [senpi#3221](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3221)). Tool calls through DeepSeek's official API, and gateways that forward to it, stop failing with `400 Invalid schema ... got 'type: null'`, because every tool schema now declares a root `type: "object"` ([senpi#3250](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3250)). The Claude subscription lane runs Claude Code 2.1.296 ([senpi#3258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3258)), the model catalog is refreshed from the live providers ([senpi#3248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3248)), large eval data cells no longer stall the shared host ([senpi#3206](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3206)), and RPC clients see a scheduled goal continuation and can run it now ([senpi#3208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3208)). Full notes: [senpi 2026.10.13](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.13).

**Daemon-hosted background tasks keep running when their parent exits or starts a new session.** The parent detaches without aborting their turns. On `/new` or exit, one notice names the old session and the `omo --resume` command to collect results; children stay owned by that session. Local in-process and stdio children retain their shutdown behavior. ([#8517](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8517), [#10018](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10018))

**A child that stops answering no longer hangs a task indefinitely.** Stdio RPC requests have deadlines, and both process runners keep one heartbeat in flight. Three missed ten-second probes end a running child as `child-unresponsive`, preserve its transcript, and name how to inspect and rerun it in `task_output`. The last successful heartbeat appears as `last_seen_at` in the live task snapshot. ([#10017](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10017))

**Resuming a background task no longer waits for a free slot.** When its concurrency group is full, resuming a finished background task now returns at once as pending and sends the follow-up when a slot frees, instead of blocking the call. A second resume of the same task while one is queued is refused, cancelling a queued resume releases nothing it didn't hold, and a fallback retry keeps the latest follow-up prompt. Thanks to @imadal1n. ([#9985](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9985))

**A task child started as its own process never receives its fallback chain after its first prompt.** When the engine answered the capability check only after the chain deadline, the runner still sent `set_retry_fallback` once the first prompt was already out; it now drops the chain at the deadline, and the child keeps the manager's fallback with the usual "no answer" warning. This was the intermittent windows-latest test failure. ([#9582](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9582), [#10087](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10087))

**ulw-execute stops a checkpoint that keeps failing instead of retrying it for days.** After the same failure twice in a row, a third failed attempt, or four hours open, the checkpoint and every checkpoint that depends on it are marked blocked (`[~]`) with the gap left, recorded in the ledger and the final report, and the run moves on to the rest of the plan. A broken test harness gets one repair attempt, and work found while a checkpoint is open is queued after it unless it blocks that checkpoint. ([#10051](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10051))

**Mass research plans its whole collection before it starts instead of one wave at a time.** `mass ulw research` now defines every angle as a harvest, expand and verify chain that passes its findings to the next step through a file, so a fast angle reaches verification while slow ones are still harvesting, and leads that are still open join each cluster of angles as soon as that cluster settles. The mass-ulw and ulw-execute skills no longer say a single node's completion wakes the session; only a finished or paused run does. ([#10049](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10049))

versions.name: v5.1.32
versions.body:
**5.1.32 is the release that 5.1.31 was meant to be: 5.1.31 never reached npm.** Two checks in the release pipeline stopped it before any package was published, one on the macOS Intel desktop engine and one on the Linux musl builds. omo itself did not change between the two, so every entry below is new to anyone upgrading from 5.1.30. The notarization check now waits for Apple's ticket to reach Gatekeeper, and the musl smoke no longer reports an exited host supervisor as a leak. ([#10081](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10081), [#10082](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10082))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.12, and long sessions stop growing with every shell command.** A finished bash session used to keep its whole headless terminal screen (10,000 lines of scrollback plus replay history, about 20 MB for a 4,000-line output) until the 32-session limit evicted it, so a busy session or task host grew by that much per command; it now keeps only its final visible screen and its bounded output, and a live terminal's replay history is stored as flat strings instead of about 31 bytes per character. After an accepted compaction, prompts, retries and resumes use the compacted context, so a session that fits is no longer refused with "Context remains above the compaction threshold" or compacted twice. When one provider account runs out of quota, its other models are skipped, compaction runs on a model that can still answer, and the error names the provider, the reset time and the `/model` way out instead of raw 429 JSON. ChatGPT-subscription GPT-6.1 Sol, Fast and Ultrafast get a 500,000-token context window. Web search uses the active model's own server-side search first on routes where it was tested live, and falls back once to the standalone search if that fails. Prompt-cache prewarm is now opt-in (`promptCache.keepAlive.enabled`) and starts only on your first edit, never on session start or resume. RPC clients gain `eval_cells.list`/`peek`/`stop`, and a shared host that is shutting down refuses new sessions with `host_stopping` instead of adopting them. Thanks to @MoerAI and @Bearmancer. ([senpi#3171](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3171), [senpi#3170](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3170), [senpi#3137](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3137), [senpi#3062](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3062), [senpi#3131](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3131), [senpi#3150](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3150), [senpi#3122](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3122), [senpi#3140](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3140), [senpi#3072](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3072), [senpi#3059](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3059), [senpi#3101](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3101), [senpi#3055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3055)) ([#10069](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10069))

**The Recommended model profile is gone: with no model profile set, OmO starts on Daily · Normal.** A fresh OmO Desktop or headless session with no `model_profile` applies Daily · Normal (Claude Opus 5.5, then Kimi K3, then GLM 5.3). If none of those is connected, it uses the first lane that is: Daily · Heavy, Geeky · Normal, then Geeky · Heavy, so a ChatGPT-only setup starts on Geeky · Normal. A config that still says `model_profile: "recommended"` gets the same default and one log line; it is never an error, and `omo.json` is not rewritten. A `model_profiles.recommended` you defined yourself still applies. The interactive TUI is unchanged. Requested by @code-yeongyu. ([#10029](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10029))

**Session tools find sessions kept in OpenCode's older storage, and show the real error instead of `[object Object]`.** A session that exists only in OpenCode's legacy JSON storage is listed, but the SQLite server answers `NotFoundError` for it; `session_search`, `session_list`, `session_read` and `session_info` now read such a session from the older storage instead of failing. Any other error reads as its name and message, and when `session_search` or `session_list` (without a date filter) still cannot read a session, it skips it and names it at the end instead of failing the whole call. Thanks to @crazyrabbit0 for the reproduction. ([#5854](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/5854), [#10041](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10041))

**Ultrawork tracks task-owned worktrees and runtime caches when they are created.** Cleanup guidance now scopes cache paths before task commands, requires path-specific todos and removal receipts, and preserves worktrees still needed by open PRs without wiping shared caches. Native full and compact directives, Codex, and OpenCode variants carry the same lifecycle; co-loaded workflows refer to it instead of repeating it. ([#9951](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9951), [#9953](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9953))
**Computer use can list and choose menu commands on Linux.** On X11 and Wayland, `menus.items` and `menus.select` walk a window's menu bar through AT-SPI and run the chosen item's own activation action, without focusing or raising the window. The request is bound to the exact window you named, so a same-titled sibling window of the same app is refused rather than used, and ambiguous, disabled or submenu labels are refused before anything runs. Selecting a menu command also no longer crashes GTK apps on Ubuntu 22.04. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651), [#9994](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9994))

**Computer use can take a screenshot and read a window's accessibility tree in one step.** `observe()` on a window returns both together, and a failed or cancelled observation normally leaves the previous screenshot and accessibility references in place. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651))

**Computer use can zoom into part of a screenshot at full detail without changing where clicks land.** `zoom(region)` on the desktop, a window or a display captures that region again at native resolution, while later clicks and typing still use the coordinates of the last full screenshot. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651))

**Computer use can list and choose menu commands on Windows.** `menus.items` and `menus.select` read a window's classic menu bar directly, or its UI Automation menu when it has none, and run the chosen command without keyboard input. Elevated windows, ambiguous or disabled labels, submenus, and menus that change mid-request are refused before anything runs; apps that take focus while they act are refused in the background and work with `delivery: "foreground"`. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651), [#9991](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9991))

**Computer use screenshots the monitor you are working on by default, and `computer.display(id)` reaches any other one.** An unset `computer.display` now captures the active monitor, the one the focused window mostly sits on, instead of compositing every display; `"all"` and display ids work as before. `computer.display("all" | "active" | id)` gives a screenshot and input handle for one display without changing the session default, and `computer.displays()` lists every monitor. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651), [#9995](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9995))

**OpenCode requests now follow the selected model's live capabilities instead of a stale model cache.** When OpenCode passes the live model to `chat.params`, its variants, thinking support, temperature support and output limit take precedence over the cached provider list, and the SDK's `provider.info.id` provider context is accepted alongside `provider.id`; calls that carry only model IDs keep the cached and bundled fallback. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#10001](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10001))

**`background_task.taskCleanupDelayMs` now also sets how long finished background tasks stay retrievable.** A delay longer than 30 minutes is no longer cut short; leaving it unset keeps the existing timing. Thanks to @imadal1n. ([#9984](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9984))

**The MCP OAuth callback server answers errors in plain text.** Its not-found, provider-error and missing-parameter responses are now sent as `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, so an `error_description` in the callback URL is shown as text and never rendered as HTML. MCP sign-in currently runs through a second callback server that never echoed that text, so nothing you see changes; consolidating the two is tracked separately. Thanks to @niStee. ([#6464](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/6464), [#9979](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9979))

**OpenCode task delegation and team creation now honor `claude_code.agents: false`, so disabled Claude Code agents fail fast instead of being selected.** Thanks to @cynkai. ([#8744](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8744), [#8802](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/8802))

**Delegated OpenCode sessions show their task category in the title.** Background, synchronous and fallback-created child sessions prefix the category while keeping the description and agent suffix; tasks without a category keep their existing title. ([#6854](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6854), [#7256](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/7256))

**OpenCode runtime fallback can switch models after a provider content-filter error.** When fallback is enabled and alternate models are configured, a blocked response advances to a different model; the existing attempt limit and chain exhaustion still stop retries. ([#6796](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6796), [#7257](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/7257))

**Memory facts are extracted only after you type a prompt.** Pending facts no longer start a model call when a session starts, rebinds, resumes or forks; extraction waits for a real prompt of yours in a top-level session. It runs on `memory.facts.model`, a configured quick chain or the session's own model, and with none of those available the queue stays pending without recording a failure. ([#9922](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9922), [#9954](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9954))

**Naming a `ulw-*` skill no longer switches on ultrawork.** `ulw-plan`, `ulw-research`, `ulw-execute` and `ulw-loop` in a prompt leave ultrawork off, while a bare `ulw` or `ultrawork` still turns it on. ([#6876](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6876), [#7255](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/7255))

**Tests now catch environment leaks at the file that causes them.** A test file that leaves `process.env` changed fails with the names of the changed keys, and the next file starts from a clean environment. Thanks to @Dante-dan. ([#9390](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9390), [#9469](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9469))

versions.name: v5.1.30
versions.body:
**`ulw-research` reads sources in your own browser instead of fetching them.** The Phase 0 brief now decides `Collection: search-only | browser` by one rule (search-only only when a result snippet settles every axis), and the web workers read every candidate through the `browser` skill's attached engine: one named session per worker, one tab per source, several tabs side by side while comparing, with a full-page screenshot per top source. `webfetch` is reserved for raw files, hosts the browser cannot open go to `ultimate-browsing` with their provenance, and a team member's brief names the `browser` skill to read since members cannot carry `load_skills`. `ultimate-browsing` no longer presents itself as the research browsing lane, and the `browser` skill no longer sends plain page reading elsewhere. ([#9958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9958), [#9959](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9959))

**Your first real prompt starts onboarding, not opening a session.** First-run context now rides along with the first prompt you actually send, without a separate model turn. The agent answers your request first, then offers the tour. Background, preview and headless sessions no longer use up onboarding, the TUI shows a static welcome until you ask something, and a failed or aborted first turn frees onboarding to try again. `--onboard` still starts the tour right away in the TUI, and in RPC it applies to the first real prompt. ([#9905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9905), [#9907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9907))

**Custom category models keep their own reasoning settings when background work starts or resumes.** A category with a model override or a `models` chain no longer inherits the builtin category's variant. Reasoning is resolved against the model actually selected before dispatch, with `reasoning` taking precedence over `reasoningEffort` and the legacy `variant`, and a resumed task keeps that model's generation settings. Builtin categories keep their existing defaults. Thanks to @MoerAI, @willowite and @pointfish6660. ([#8510](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8510), [#9013](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9013))

**Groundwork for OmO accounts: `omo login`, `omo whoami` and `omo logout` ship ahead of the account service, which hasn't launched yet.** Until it does, `omo login` checks the service first and stops at once with a one-line error naming the service address, instead of opening a browser or waiting, and `omo whoami` reports that you aren't signed in. When the service launches, sign-in will use a browser flow or a headless device-code flow (`--device` or `--no-browser`), keep credentials and device keys only in the operating system's credential store (Keychain on macOS, Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows) with no plaintext fallback, and keep a sign-in through connection and browser-launch failures. ([#9829](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9829), [#9811](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9811), [#9831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9831), [#9833](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9833))

**A child stopped during parent teardown no longer briefly reports a failure of its own.** An unexpected exit is now held for a two-second confirmation window. If the owning manager survives, a genuine failure is reported; if the owner exits first, recovery records the interrupted work as `lost` without replaying it. Recovery also revisits children it had deferred to another live owner once that owner has exited, so those records no longer stay stranded. ([#9715](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9715), [#9884](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9884))

**One `task` call can submit more than 16 child tasks.** The per-call batch cap is gone from both validation and execution. Global, provider and model concurrency limits still decide how many children run at once; the rest queue and start as slots free up. Synchronous batch results still come back in input order. ([#9854](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9854), [#9859](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9859))

**`unspecified-low` uses GPT-6.1 Sol at medium reasoning on the OpenAI lanes.** The default chain adds `gpt-6.1-sol` for OpenAI API and ChatGPT Subscription ahead of the older GPT fallback. GPT-5.6 Terra is replaced by GPT-5.6 Sol at medium reasoning, which keeps a supported fallback for GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and catalogs without 6.1 Sol. Other categories keep their defaults. ([#9844](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9844), [#9845](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9845))

**Windows hook commands and plugin updates no longer open extra console windows.** Claude-compatible hooks and helper probes now hide their child consoles, so a GUI-launched session doesn't get a terminal flash or a focus-stealing window on every hook. The shared Bun spawn path applies the same setting, and OmO's Codex plugin hides consoles for background updates, version checks and manual-update commands. ([#7144](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7144), [#9837](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9837), [#9840](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9840), [#9841](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9841), [#9838](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9838), [#9839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9839))

**OpenCode session tools can find sessions across projects, not just the current server directory.** Session listing and cross-session search use the paginated global session endpoint when it's available, keep their project and date filters, and fall back to the existing session list when it isn't. Search still caps how many sessions it scans. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#5810](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/5810), [#9023](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9023))

**Computer use can inspect and select macOS menu-bar commands by their menu path.** `win.menu.items(path?)` lists titles, paths, enabled and checked states, submenus and shortcuts, and `win.menu.select(path)` invokes one unambiguous, enabled leaf command. Selection re-checks the target window and command right before dispatch and restores the keyboard context afterwards. Ambiguous labels, disabled items and submenu-only targets are refused, and on macOS an app with several windows is refused rather than risking the wrong one. The API is cross-platform, but native support in this release is macOS only. ([#9875](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9875), [#9881](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9881), [#9886](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9886))

**Setting a macOS popup now picks the option instead of reporting an ignored write as success.** `el.setValue(text)` opens the popup's menu, selects the exact matching option and verifies the result. Missing, ambiguous and disabled options are refused with the available choices. A menu the call opened is closed again whether selection succeeds or fails, while one that was already open is left alone. Pull-down popups aren't supported yet. ([#9852](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9852))

**Computer use can write ISO-8601 values to macOS date and time controls.** `el.setValue(text)` now writes a native date and reads it back to verify. A date-only value keeps the current time of day, local date-times use the system time zone, and values with `Z` or a numeric offset name an exact instant. Malformed input, and local times that daylight saving skips or repeats, are refused rather than quietly shifted. ([#9853](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9853))

**Computer-use timeout messages show where the desktop engine stopped answering.** A failed startup probe now names its handshake phase: neither reply yet, `engine.hello` answered while capabilities are pending, or capabilities answered while `engine.hello` is pending. A stalled engine is easier to diagnose when every timeout no longer looks the same. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#9720](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9720), [#9742](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9742), [#9916](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9916))

**Foreground computer use now needs your explicit OK.** Before the model can type, click in the foreground or raise a window, its computer code calls `desktop.control.acquire({ reason })`, and OmO asks you to confirm with that reason. Only an explicit yes grants control; declining, letting the 45-second prompt time out, a headless run or a read-only run all leave it ungranted. The grant ends when the model releases it, when the run ends or fails, on the stop chord, or when the session closes, and resuming never restores it. One session's grant is never taken over by another. Background delivery is unchanged and stays the default. ([#9899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9899), [#9908](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9908))

**Thread bindings accept WhatsApp as a native platform.** `thread_bind` and the session-gateway store now accept `whatsapp` instead of refusing a connector's first message, and existing bindings are kept as the store upgrades. This is the core binding support a WhatsApp connector needs; it doesn't install or link one by itself. ([#9871](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9871))

**Workflow node IDs are checked before their results are stored.** Empty IDs, `.` and `..`, path separators, colons and NUL bytes are rejected with `invalid_node_id` instead of being used to build result paths, and the result store refuses unsafe paths too. An existing run whose node IDs contain those characters can't resume its saved results after upgrading: rename the nodes and restart the run. Thanks to @DeryFerd. ([#9869](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9869))

**Mass-ulw joins adjacent all-to-all waves through one review node.** The planning guide now puts a single verification node between two complete waves instead of drawing every producer-to-consumer edge. A finding reruns only the producer it names, and a consumer that needs just one branch waits on that branch's review alone. ([#9866](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9866))

**omo.dev download stats are set to refresh hourly.** The downloads worker now schedules its rollup at 17 minutes past each hour, so the public stats update regularly once the worker runs with its analytics credential. Nothing changes in your local install. ([#9827](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9827))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.11, and a task shard stops soon after the session that owns it exits.** Task shards are now started with senpi's caller-lifetime ownership, so a multi-GB `p-*` shard host no longer stays resident for the full idle window after its owning session quits; peers and running turns still keep it alive. The engine also waits for its host child to really exit before releasing a stopped host, and required compaction no longer wedges on an unsafe newest message. Long sessions stop rewriting the prompt cache every turn: context reduction holds a stable prefix between large steps and survives restarts. OpenAI models behind a Responses-compatible gateway no longer fail every turn with `Invalid value: 'allowed_tools'`. The footer shows a reasoning model's level as `effort <level>` next to the key that changes it (`shift+tab` by default) when the footer has room. Reloading a session no longer keeps the previous extension runner in memory, and the runtime snapshot a first launch builds leaves out dependency development trees and redundant TypeScript sources. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-12](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-12) and [senpi 2026.10.11](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.11). (code-yeongyu/senpi#3044, code-yeongyu/senpi#3054, code-yeongyu/senpi#3060, code-yeongyu/senpi#900, code-yeongyu/senpi#3080, code-yeongyu/senpi#3090, code-yeongyu/senpi#3066, code-yeongyu/senpi#3083, [#9876](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9876), [#9976](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9976))

**Suspended children no longer linger in the task list: each one resumes or ends on its own.** A child that was parked while it could not run is now revived as soon as it can be, or ends within a bounded recovery window with one final result, so it never sits in the task list as suspended. Messages sent to it meanwhile are queued and delivered in order when it resumes; if it can't resume, the parent is told in that one result how many messages were not delivered, and `task_output` then shows `error` rather than the original status. ([#9861](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9861), [#9868](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9868))

versions.name: v5.1.29
versions.body:
**Child tasks and Kibitzer wakes of a fast-mode session no longer fail with `model_unavailable`: a `-fast` pin is accepted when the session starts on its paired base model.** Since 5.1.25, a category pinned to a `-fast` catalog variant such as `chatgpt-subscription/gpt-6-luna-fast` was refused after start, because senpi starts a `-fast` pin on its base model with the priority tier. Kibitzer recall wakes failed on every wake, and the built-in fast-first chains (`quick`, `deep-low`, `deep-high`, `ultrabrain`) silently skipped their first model. A run that started on the standard tier instead of priority is now accepted and recorded on the task (`effective_model.service_tier`) instead of refused. ([#9793](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9793), [#9808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9808), [#9812](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9812), [#9813](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9813))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10-11.** `tool_schema("eval:environments")` now documents `packages.install` and its `environment_install_timeout`, so JavaScript and Python cells can discover how to install packages without changing the default eval description or parameters. Julia, Ruby and Python cells do less fixed work per cell: no globals walk below the memory thresholds, no awaited cwd stat, and leaner Python queue and capture bookkeeping. A scheduled prompt created in a desktop thread before the OmO desktop moved that folder now fires, and `--session`, `--resume` and `--continue` find such sessions in the folder's new home. A session another live process already holds is refused with a typed `session_held` error instead of being opened twice. Sessions that share MCP servers but resolve different MCP configs no longer break each other's tools. A goal whose continuation stops also stops its timer. On Windows, stopping a command's process tree can no longer kill an unrelated process that reused a pid. On macOS and Linux, processes a JavaScript eval cell starts get their own process group, so a group kill can't stop the agent, and leftover grandchildren are stopped when the cell ends. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-11](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-11). ### Fixed

**A background child no longer stays suspended while its parent is running.** A child parked while its parent session was still live was only revisited at the parent's next start, so it could sit suspended for hours and a goal waiting on its result waited forever. It is now revived right away, or ends with one result. ([#9350](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9350), [#9799](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9799))

**omo.dev shows its live stats more reliably.** A cold page load whose first stats refresh hit one upstream blip showed the fallback numbers; it now falls back to the last complete set instead.
